class_name: 放置-非実現-ナイデシマウ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Reports that an action ended up never happening, with the regret しまう adds in this construction (読まないでしまった). Nothing was intended, unlike ないでおく, and the window has closed, unlike ないでいる. The frozen noun 〜ずじまい, built from the same ず + しまい, is far commoner in contemporary Japanese; 〜ずにしまう is also easily read as the lexical 仕舞う 'put away' (使わずにしまった), so context has to force the aspectual reading.

examples.ruby: せっかくの休[やす]みなのに、どこにも出[で]かけないでしまった。
examples.english: I finally had time off, and ended up going nowhere at all.

examples.ruby: 借[か]りた本[ほん]を、とうとう読[よ]まないでしまった。
examples.english: In the end I never got around to reading the book I'd borrowed.

examples.ruby: 同僚[どうりょう]には結局[けっきょく]相談[そうだん]しないでしまった。
examples.english: In the end I never did bring it up with my colleague.
